author: Codex assisted team authoring
review: No independent human or native Portuguese review. Labels are author-defined test expectations, not ground truth about production customers.
group_policy: Each bilingual pair shares a semantic_group and stays within one split. No exact normalized-text duplicates across splits. Top-level intents necessarily recur; scenario motifs and wording were authored separately. This is a synthetic challenge suite, not a natural-demand sample.
split_policy: Train/dev/test frozen before evaluation; model fitted only on train, hyperparameters/threshold selected only on dev. Future test-driven improvements require a new untouched benchmark.
